messages:
alex: T-minus 20m for the launch. Quick compact checklist below — calling for final ack and smoke ownership. Please reply with role + quick ack.

alex: Checklist:
- infra toggles verified (metrics + tracer)
- DB migrations: none in this release 
- Feature flags: `feature_x = on` in prod config
- Canary slice = 0.5% for first 10m then 5%
- Rollback plan confirmed (pin to v2.0.9)

alex: Smoke command (run from ./deploy-tools):
```
./scripts/smoke_check.sh --env=prod --timeout=60
```

maria: infra ok from my side. VMs health + autoscaler rules look normal. ack (infra). :white_check_mark:

sam: CI green + canary artifacts pushed. I will kick the smoke in 10m and watch token/API error rates. (sam) :thumbsup:

devops-bot: CI pipeline passed — 7 jobs succeeded, 0 failed. artifact:v2.1.3 tagged.

jess: I have tracing dashboards ready and a quick alert rule to page on >3% 5m error rate. toggles confirmed. ack (observability).

ryan: app team ack. I have the rollback command handy: `redwoodctl release rollback --to v2.0.9 --force` and will stand by.

alex: @maria @sam @jess @ryan thanks. Who will act as rollback owner if we need to revert in first 30m?

maria: I can take rollback owner for first 15m then hand to ryan if we need longer.

sam: I'll be on pager for the first 30m and will run the smoke/checks and coordinate rollback.

jess: Observability standby — will confirm latency and error baselines at +5m and +15m.

ci-bot: Smoke job queued. To run execute: `ci run smoke-prod v2.1.3` — triggered by sam.

alex: Final quick notes: keep the canary small, no schema changes, no config drift. If anything spikes, abort and rollback. Please reply with "ack" + role if you haven't yet.

ryan: ack (app/rollback backup).

sam: ack (smoke/primary). running smoke in 9m.

maria: ack (infra/rollback lead first 15m).

jess: ack (obs).

alex: Great — starting quiet-window in 5m. I'll post a launch update with timestamps. :rocket:
